overview: Jido Core 2.0 needs clear, comprehensive documentation that makes it easy for both new and experienced Elixir developers to understand, adopt, and extend the framework. This includes complete moduledocs and function docs for all public APIs, high-level guides that explain the architecture and core concepts (agents, workflows, supervision, configuration, extension points), and runnable examples that demonstrate typical usage patterns and best practices. Key deliverables include: moduledocs for all public-facing modules and functions; a set of narrative guides (Getting Started, Architecture Overview, Writing Agents, Configuration, Testing, Extending Jido); and one or more example projects showing end-to-end flows. Risks include documentation drift if APIs change, and balancing big-picture narrative with low-level details.
title: Write comprehensive documentation — moduledocs, guides, examples
